commerce.demoNote: Demo: synthetic requests, quotes and prices from the demo fixtures. Nothing here is a real company, offer or signature, and no action is sent.
commerce.demoNotSent: Demo: the data passed the checks, but nothing was sent. A live deployment records this action.
commerce.amountInvalid: Enter an amount such as 1250.50, with no more decimal places than the currency allows.

obligation.pay: Pay the total through the agreed payment provider

list.noRfqs: No requests yet. A need becomes a request once nothing is missing.
list.staleInvitations: {count, plural, one {# invitation answers an earlier version} other {# invitations answer an earlier version}}

lines.title: Lines
lines.empty: Add at least one line: what is needed.
lines.quantityInvalid: Enter a positive number such as 12 or 2.5.
lines.hint: Empty new lines are ignored. Save to add more lines.

missing.lines: What is needed: add at least one line.
missing.quantity: Line {n}: how much, and in which unit?
missing.region: Where should it be delivered or done?
missing.acceptance: How will you accept the result?

need.newLede: Describe what you need in your own words. Your agent can help, but nothing is sent to anyone until you publish a request.
need.privateNote: A need is visible only to you and the people you work with on it
need.untrustedNote: Data from a file or an e-mail are assumptions until you confirm them. Addresses found in an e-mail are never used to contact anyone.
need.title: Title
need.windowInvalid: Enter both dates; the end cannot be before the start.
need.saved: Saved. The checklist shows what is still missing.
need.nothingMissing: Nothing is missing: the need can become a request.
need.converted: This need has become a request.

convert.title: Turn into a request
convert.body: The lines, place, timing and acceptance requirements become version 1 of a request. It stays a draft until you publish it.
convert.notReady: When nothing is missing, you can turn the need into a request to suppliers.
convert.currencyInvalid: Enter a three-letter currency code, for example USD.
convert.deadlineInvalid: Choose a response deadline in the future.

rfq.regionRequired: Choose the place of delivery or works.
rfq.acceptanceRequired: Describe how the result will be accepted.
rfq.immutable: Published on {date}. A published version never changes; the digest identifies it.
rfq.draftFirst: Draft of the first version. Suppliers see it only after you publish it.
rfq.draftAmendment: Draft of an amendment ({reason}). Publishing it marks quotes for the earlier version as stale.
rfq.publishBody: The version becomes final and can be sent to suppliers. Changes later are only possible as a new version.
rfq.publishAmendmentBody: The version becomes final. Quotes and invitations for the earlier version are marked as stale and are not compared with the new one.
rfq.amendNote: Changes create a new version of the request. Quotes already received will be marked as stale.
rfq.closeBody: Suppliers can no longer answer it. Invitations are marked as closed.

invite.title: Invite suppliers
invite.body: The invitation pins the current published version. Only companies and people on the platform can be invited.
invite.outreachNote: Contact obtained from a public source; outreach without consent is not permitted. Such pages are listed but cannot be invited.
invite.choose: Choose a supplier that may be invited.
invite.publishFirst: Publish the request first: invitations and quotes always refer to a published version.
invite.revalidateBody: A new invitation pins the current version. The earlier invitation stays in the history as stale.
invite.withdrawBody: The supplier can no longer answer this invitation.
invite.done: The supplier is invited to the current version.

quotes.empty: No quotes yet. {count, plural, one {# supplier} other {# suppliers}} invited to the current version.

compare.lede: Only quotes for version {version} are compared, line by line, without unit conversion. A total appears only when every line matches.
compare.caption: Quotes for version {version} of the request
compare.includeStale: Show stale quotes ({count}) as not comparable
compare.empty: No quote answers the current version yet.
compare.agreementExists: Terms are already accepted for this request.

reason.scope_mismatch: not every line matches the request

compare.extras: {count, plural, one {# unsolicited line is} other {# unsolicited lines are}} shown in the quote but not part of the total.
compare.historicalTitle: Not comparable with the current version
compare.historicalBody: These versions answer an earlier version of the request or were replaced. They are kept as history, without totals or ranking.

accept.title: Accept the terms of {supplier}?
accept.body: You accept exactly this quote version for exactly this request version. Both are fixed by their digests.
accept.notOrder: Accepting the terms is not yet an order: you place the order next, with your authority and a transaction budget, and the supplier accepts it separately.
accept.unknown: The result is not known yet. We are checking it; do not repeat the action. Reload the page in a moment.

consent.label: I agree to keep this acceptance as an electronic record and to sign it electronically.
consent.disclosure: Disclosure {key} of this hub. You can ask for a paper copy and withdraw this consent for future records.
consent.required: Confirm your consent to electronic records to continue.
consent.changed: This hub uses a different disclosure. Read it and confirm again.

negotiation.requestBody: Name target prices or reasons for exact lines. The supplier answers with a new version; the sent version never changes.
negotiation.requested: The request is sent to the supplier.
negotiation.nothingAsked: Name at least one target price or reason.
negotiation.answerTitle: Answer the request with a new version?
negotiation.answerBody: A new draft opens from your latest version. Change the prices and send it; the sent version stays as it is.

order.none: No terms are accepted yet. Compare the quotes and select one.
order.snapshot: Snapshot of the quote of {date}, version {version}
order.immutable: The terms are fixed and do not change when the supplier's catalogue is updated.
order.authorityCompany: Your company right to run deals
order.noMandate: No mandate for this action: your assistant cannot place this order
order.authorityInsufficient: Insufficient authority for this order. Ask for the right to run deals or for an approval.
order.budgetHint: The order reserves its total from this budget. Budgets are granted in billing; their list comes with the budget screens.
order.budgetRequired: Name the transaction budget for the reservation.
order.sellerAccepted: The supplier accepted the order on {date}
order.notAvailable: The order cannot be placed in this state.
order.outcomeUnknown: Outcome unknown, reconciliation in progress. The order will not be placed again automatically.
order.sameRequestNote: If no order appears after checking, you may send the same request again: it carries the same key, so a second order can never be created from it.
order.cancelBody: Possible until the supplier accepts. The budget reservation is released.
order.withdrawBody: Possible until the supplier accepts the order.

approvals.note: Every acceptance is recorded with the digest of the exact terms. Your assistant acts only under a structured mandate; its proposed actions would appear here with their digests for your approval.

sales.privacyNote: You see the request the buyer shared with you. The buyer's budget, notes and other invited suppliers are never shown.
sales.rfqChanged: The request has changed (version {version}). Your quote refers to version {old}.
sales.rfqChangedUnknown: The request has changed. Your quote refers to version {old}.
sales.waitRevalidation: The buyer has not invited you to the new version yet.
sales.prepareBody: A draft opens with the lines of version {version} of the request. Nothing is sent until you send a version.
sales.markViewedBody: The buyer sees that you have opened the request.
sales.declineBody: The buyer sees that you will not quote.

quote.title: Quote
quote.createForNew: Create a version for the new request
quote.createForNewTitle: Create a version for version {version} of the request?
quote.createForNewBody: A new draft answers the current request; quantities follow the new version. The earlier version stays as history and is not compared.
quote.newVersionBody: A new draft opens from version {version}. Version {version} stays as it was sent.
quote.withdrawBody: The buyer can no longer accept it.
quote.sentImmutable: Version {version} was sent on {date} and does not change. Changes are only possible as a new version.
quote.substitutionReason: Why an alternative is offered, line {n}
quote.floor: Minimum price, line {n} (not sent to the buyer)
quote.floorHint: Visible only to you; your assistant never offers below it.
quote.floorWarning: Line {n}: the price is below your minimum price.
quote.milestoneInvalid: Describe the step and choose its date.
quote.validityInvalid: Choose a validity date in the future.
quote.sendConfirm: Once sent, the version does not change. Changes are only possible as a new version.
quote.sent: Version {version} is sent to the buyer.
quote.totalsOnSave: Line amounts and totals are recalculated exactly when you save.
quote.milestonesHint: Leave a row empty to skip it; save to add another.

sellerOrder.none: No order yet. When the buyer accepts your terms and places the order, you accept or decline it here.
sellerOrder.acceptBody: You accept exactly the terms with digest {digest}. Obligations follow from them.
sellerOrder.declineBody: The order is cancelled. The buyer releases its budget reservation.
sellerOrder.awaitingOrder: The buyer accepted your terms; the order is not placed yet.

demo.lineGoods: Steel beams, I-section 300 mm, grade S355
demo.specAlternative: Equivalent section from another rolling mill
demo.acceptance: Delivery note signed on site; certificates of conformity attached.
demo.paymentTerms: 30% advance, the rest within 14 days of acceptance.
demo.amendmentReason: Quantity changed after the structural review
demo.substitutionReason: Shorter lead time for an equivalent section
demo.requestReason: Above the market level we see
demo.internalNotes: Demo note: keep within the approved budget.
demo.sellerNotes: Demo note: margin is thin; do not go lower.
